# Configuration Reference

Every environment variable idmagic reads at startup, grouped by the processes that read it.
Values are validated before any process opens a listener, connects to a dependency, or applies a
seed: a missing required value, a malformed or out-of-range value, and a conflicting combination
all abort startup with every problem reported at once.

A `secret` value is never written to an error message, a log line, or this reference.

## Shared

Read by: idmagic, idmagic-worker, idmagic-batch, idmagic-seed

Persistence, notification, WebAuthn, authorization, and key-custody settings every process assembles its adapters from.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PERSISTENCE` | enum: `memory`, `postgres` | `memory` | no | Storage backend. `postgres` requires DATABASE_URL. |
| `OBSERVABILITY` | enum: `noop`, `otel` | `noop` | no | Set to `otel` to export OTLP traces and metrics. Pull-based /metrics is always served regardless of this setting. |
| `AUTHZEN` | enum: `local`, `remote` | `local` | no | Authorization decision point. `remote` delegates to an AuthZEN PDP and requires AUTHZEN_URL. |
| `AUTHZEN_URL` | url | — | when `AUTHZEN=remote` | AuthZEN policy decision point endpoint. Required when AUTHZEN=remote. |
| `WEBAUTHN_RP_ID` | string | — | no | WebAuthn relying-party ID, e.g. `localhost`. WebAuthn and passkeys stay disabled while it is unset. |
| `WEBAUTHN_RP_ORIGINS` | list | — | when `WEBAUTHN_RP_ID is set` | Browser origins allowed to run WebAuthn ceremonies, e.g. `http://localhost:5173`. Required when WEBAUTHN_RP_ID is set. |
| `WEBAUTHN_RP_DISPLAY_NAME` | string | `idmagic` | no | Relying-party display name shown by authenticators. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | secret | — | when `PERSISTENCE=postgres` | PostgreSQL connection string. Required when PERSISTENCE=postgres. |
| `DB_MAX_CONNS` | integer (>= 0) | `20` | no | Upper bound on the PostgreSQL connection pool. |
| `DB_MIN_CONNS` | integer (>= 0) | `2` | no | Connections the pool keeps warm. |
| `DB_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME` | duration (> 0) | `30s` | no | Idle time after which a pooled connection is closed. |
| `DB_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME` | duration (> 0) | `1h0m0s` | no | Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection. |
| `DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | duration (> 0) | `5s` | no | Deadline for establishing a PostgreSQL connection. |
| `DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT` | duration (> 0) | `5s` | no | Deadline for a single query, held until its results are fully read. |
| `DB_BREAKER_FAILURE_THRESHOLD` | number (0..1) | `0.5` | no | Failure ratio at which the PostgreSQL circuit breaker opens. |
| `DB_BREAKER_COOLDOWN` | duration (> 0) | `30s` | no | How long the PostgreSQL circuit breaker stays open before probing again. |
| `DB_BREAKER_MIN_REQUESTS` | integer (>= 0) | `10` | no | Requests observed in a window before the failure ratio is allowed to open the breaker. |
| `KEY_PROVIDER` | enum: `local`, `vault` | — | no | Signing key custody. `vault` requires VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN; unset keeps keys in the application database. |
| `VAULT_ADDR` | string | — | when `KEY_PROVIDER=vault` | Vault base address. Required when KEY_PROVIDER=vault. |
| `VAULT_TOKEN` | secret | — | when `KEY_PROVIDER=vault` | Vault token. Required when KEY_PROVIDER=vault. |
| `VAULT_TRANSIT_MOUNT` | string | — | no | Vault Transit engine mount path used for signing keys. |
| `VAULT_KEY_PREFIX` | string | — | no | Prefix for per-tenant Vault Transit signing key names. |
| `DATA_KEY_PROVIDER` | enum: `openbao` | — | no | Master-key custody for envelope-encrypted reversible secrets. `openbao` requires OPENBAO_ADDR and OPENBAO_TOKEN; unset uses an in-process cleartext keyset (development only). |
| `OPENBAO_ADDR` | string | — | when `DATA_KEY_PROVIDER=openbao` | OpenBao base address. Required when DATA_KEY_PROVIDER=openbao. |
| `OPENBAO_TOKEN` | secret | — | when `DATA_KEY_PROVIDER=openbao` | OpenBao token. Required when DATA_KEY_PROVIDER=openbao. |
| `OPENBAO_TRANSIT_MOUNT` | string | — | no | OpenBao Transit engine mount path. |
| `OPENBAO_DATA_KEY_PREFIX` | string | `idmagic/datakeys` | no | Prefix for per-tenant OpenBao Transit key names (`{prefix}/{tenant_id}`). |
| `EMAIL_SENDER` | enum: `console`, `smtp` | `console` | no | Delivery channel for password reset and notification email. `smtp` requires SMTP_HOST and SMTP_FROM. |
| `SMTP_HOST` | string | — | when `EMAIL_SENDER=smtp` | SMTP server hostname. Required when EMAIL_SENDER=smtp. |
| `SMTP_FROM` | string | — | when `EMAIL_SENDER=smtp` | From address on outgoing mail. Required when EMAIL_SENDER=smtp. |
| `SMTP_TLS` | enum: `starttls`, `implicit`, `none` | `starttls` | no | SMTP transport security. |
| `SMTP_PORT` | integer (>= 0) | `0` | no | SMTP port. `0` selects the default port for the chosen SMTP_TLS mode (587 starttls, 465 implicit, 25 none). |
| `SMTP_USERNAME` | string | — | no | SMTP username. Leave unset for an unauthenticated relay. |
| `SMTP_PASSWORD` | secret | — | no | SMTP password. |
| `SMTP_HELO` | string | — | no | HELO/EHLO name announced to the SMTP server. |
| `SMTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `10` | no | Deadline for one SMTP delivery attempt. |
| `DEFAULT_LOCALE` | string | — | no | Last-resort language for notification email. An unsupported value fails startup. |
| `BREACHED_PASSWORD_CHECKER` | enum: `noop`, `hibp` | `noop` | no | Breached-password check performed on password changes. `hibp` calls the Have I Been Pwned range API. |

## API

Read by: idmagic

HTTP listener, hardening, security headers, and endpoint rate limits.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ISSUER` | url | `http://localhost:8080` | no | Public base URL this deployment issues tokens under. It must match what relying parties resolve. |
| `ADDR` | string | `:8080` | no | Listen address of the HTTP server. |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | string | `idmagic` | no | service.name reported on logs, metrics, and traces. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `warning`, `error` | `info` | no | Minimum severity written to stdout. |
| `REQUEST_ID_TRUST_INBOUND` | boolean: `true`, `false` | `false` | no | Reuse an inbound X-Request-ID instead of generating one. Enable only behind a proxy that owns and sanitizes the header. |
| `TENANT_BASE_DOMAIN` | string | — | no | Parent hostname enabling the subdomain endpoint style at `{realm}.<domain>`, e.g. `id.example.com`. Unset keeps every tenant on path routing. |
| `TRUSTED_FORWARDED_HOPS` | integer (>= 0) | `0` | no | Number of trusted X-Forwarded-For hops in front of this process, used to resolve the real client IP for the login throttle and the endpoint rate limits. `0` distrusts the header entirely. |
| `DRAIN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECONDS` | integer (>= 0) | `5` | no | Seconds to keep serving after SIGTERM before shutting the listener down (idmagic), or to let in-flight jobs finish (idmagic-worker). |
| `PAGINATION_CURSOR_SECRET` | secret | — | no | HMAC secret signing keyset pagination cursors. Set it explicitly in any multi-replica deployment: otherwise each replica generates its own at startup and rejects cursors issued by another. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | `/token` fixed-window limit, keyed by client_id and IP. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | Window length for the `/token` limit. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_AUTHORIZE_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `30` | no | `/authorize` fixed-window limit, keyed by IP and client_id. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_AUTHORIZE_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | Window length for the `/authorize` limit. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PAR_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `30` | no | `/par` fixed-window limit, keyed by IP and client_id. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PAR_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | Window length for the `/par` limit. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_DEVICE_AUTHORIZATION_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `20` | no | `/device_authorization` fixed-window limit, keyed by client_id and IP. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_DEVICE_AUTHORIZATION_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | Window length for the `/device_authorization` limit. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_BACKCHANNEL_AUTHENTICATION_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `20` | no | `/bc-authorize` fixed-window limit, keyed by client_id and IP. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_BACKCHANNEL_AUTHENTICATION_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | Window length for the `/bc-authorize` limit. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PASSWORD_RESET_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `5` | no | `/api/auth/forgot_password` fixed-window limit, keyed by the submitted identifier and IP. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PASSWORD_RESET_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `900` | no | Window length for the password reset limit. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_MAX_REQUESTS` | integer (> 0) | `20` | no | `/api/auth/login` fixed-window limit, keyed by IP. Separate from, and in addition to, the per-account login throttle. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS` | integer (> 0) | `60` | no | Window length for the login limit. |
| `HTTP_READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT` | duration (> 0) | `10s` | no | Deadline for reading request headers. |
| `HTTP_READ_TIMEOUT` | duration (> 0) | `30s` | no | Deadline for reading a whole request. |
| `HTTP_WRITE_TIMEOUT` | duration (> 0) | `1m0s` | no | Deadline for writing a response. |
| `HTTP_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | duration (> 0) | `2m0s` | no | How long an idle keep-alive connection is held open. |
| `HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | integer (> 0) | `1048576` | no | Request body limit; a larger body is rejected with 413. |
| `CSP_REPORT_ONLY` | boolean: `true`, `false` | `false` | no | Send the Content Security Policy as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only for a staged rollout. |
| `CSP_REPORT_URI` | string | — | no | report-uri collecting Content Security Policy violations. |
| `HSTS_ENABLED` | boolean: `true`, `false` | `false` | no | Emit Strict-Transport-Security. Off by default because the TLS terminator owns it. |
| `HSTS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | integer (>= 0) | `31536000` | no | max-age of the Strict-Transport-Security header when enabled. |
| `HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS` | boolean: `true`, `false` | `true` | no | Add includeSubDomains to Strict-Transport-Security. |

## Worker

Read by: idmagic-worker

Durable job queue lanes, runner cadence, and the resident sweep loops.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | string | `idmagic-worker` | no | service.name reported on logs, metrics, and traces. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `warning`, `error` | `info` | no | Minimum severity written to stdout. |
| `ADDR` | string | `:8080` | no | Listen address of the HTTP server. |
| `WORKER_ID` | string | — | no | Identifies this worker in job leases. Defaults to the hostname, then to a generated id. |
| `JOB_WORKER_LANES` | enum list: `latency_sensitive`, `default`, `bulk` | `latency_sensitive,default,bulk` | no | Execution lanes this process claims. The default keeps one process on every lane; a per-lane production deployment sets exactly one. |
| `JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY` | integer (> 0) | `4` | no | Jobs executed in parallel per lane, unless the lane overrides it below. |
| `JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY_LATENCY_SENSITIVE` | integer (> 0) | `4` | no | Overrides JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY for the latency_sensitive lane. |
| `JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY_DEFAULT` | integer (> 0) | `4` | no | Overrides JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY for the default lane. |
| `JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY_BULK` | integer (> 0) | `4` | no | Overrides JOB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY for the bulk lane. |
| `JOB_POLL_INTERVAL` | duration (> 0) | `2s` | no | How often a runner polls its lane for claimable jobs. |
| `JOB_LEASE_DURATION` | duration (> 0) | `5m0s` | no | Lease held on a claimed job. Another worker reclaims the job once it expires. |
| `JOB_BACKOFF_BASE` | duration (> 0) | `30s` | no | First retry delay after a job attempt fails. |
| `JOB_BACKOFF_CAP` | duration (> 0) | `30m0s` | no | Upper bound on the exponential retry delay. |
| `EPHEMERAL_SWEEP_INTERVAL` | duration (> 0) | `1m0s` | no | How often expired rows in short-TTL ephemeral stores are reclaimed. |
| `SHARED_SIGNALS_DELIVERY_INTERVAL` | duration (> 0) | `5s` | no | How often due outbound Security Event Tokens are delivered. |
| `DRAIN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECONDS` | integer (>= 0) | `5` | no | Seconds to keep serving after SIGTERM before shutting the listener down (idmagic), or to let in-flight jobs finish (idmagic-worker). |

## Seed

Read by: idmagic (startup seed), idmagic-seed

The explicit seed request. idmagic applies it once at startup when SEED_PROFILE is set; idmagic-seed uses it as the default for its own flags.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEED_PROFILE` | enum: `bootstrap`, `development`, `test`, `performance` | — | no | Explicit seed profile applied at startup. Unset means no seeding. |
| `SEED_ENVIRONMENT` | enum: `development`, `test`, `staging`, `production` | — | when `SEED_PROFILE is set` | Environment the seed applies to. Required when SEED_PROFILE is set. |
| `SEED_MANIFEST` | string | — | no | Root seed manifest path. Defaults to the profile's own manifest. |
| `SEED_GENERATOR_SEED` | string | — | no | Deterministic generator seed for the performance profile. |
| `SEED_SECRET_ROOT` | string | — | no | Root directory for relative `file` secret locators in a manifest. |
| `SEED_FIRST_PARTY_REDIRECT_URIS` | list | — | when `SEED_ENVIRONMENT=production and SEED_PROFILE=bootstrap` | Redirect URIs for the seeded first-party clients. Required for a production bootstrap. |

## Externally owned variables

These are read by libraries rather than by idmagic, so they are not part of the validated
configuration above and a malformed value does not fail startup:

| Variable | Owner | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | OpenTelemetry SDK | OTLP/HTTP collector endpoint used when OBSERVABILITY=otel. |
| `VITE_DEFAULT_LOCALE` | Frontend build | Startup default UI locale baked into the React build. |
| `VITE_DEMO_LOGIN_ENABLED` | Frontend build | Shows the demo login shortcut outside the Vite dev server. |
